integrity: The two-party obstruction and complete three-party formula are analytic. The positive-grid threshold is exhaustively enumerated from every positive three-part composition of vote and seat counts through denominator 11 using exact rational arithmetic, with first-layer symmetry classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns vote-seat disproportionality vectors and the Loosemore–Hanby and Gallagher indices. The integer-grid corollary requires a common positive denominator for vote and seat shares and is a finite benchmark rather than a literal electorate-size model.
title: Three parties are the sharp Loosemore–Hanby–Gallagher ranking boundary
